_needsReview: The live docs prose for this command appears to contain a copy/paste error from FORM GOTO PAGE ("the command changes the page of the current subform") even though FORM Get current page is a read-only getter; the semanticRole below instead follows the parameter table's own description ("Returns number of current subform page"), which is consistent with the command's Integer return value and its name.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns the number of the currently displayed page of the parent form (or, if the trailing * flag is passed, of the current page-type subform), or of the form loaded via FORM LOAD.
